title: One tube lit
logline: The Lanes' sign in December with one tube lit — the L, the one that flickered in 2009 — and every other letter dark. Somebody fixed one. The page doesn't say who.

panels.composition: A bowling alley's neon sign at night with every letter dark but one, which glows, above a wet empty lot.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bowling alley's neon sign at night with every letter dark except one glowing letter above a wet empty lot, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
